objective.title: Qualify bounded exact symbolic transformations with domain-safe substitution and real square root

declared.summary: Qualify M4-W01-C03-T1 through a compiled missing-API RED, 28 independent GREEN tests and eight NuGet-only consumer oracles. Add provider-free symbolics preview.3 closed exact binomial expansion/factorization, identity-based free-symbol substitution that refuses binder capture, and real sqrt(x²) normalization to abs(x) unless a retained typed nonnegative hypothesis permits x. Inspect three local packages, their SHA-256s and relevant IR/quantities regressions; keep C03-T2 and M4-W01 open.
declared.value: Deliver small, executable, exact symbolic transformations without inventing equivalence, losing domain assumptions or introducing a mandatory CAS or agent broker dependency.
debtChanges: One real compiled RED runs against existing symbolics preview.2 before staging the new public bounded exact transformation API.
28 independently authored GREEN tests check exact binomial coefficients, factor/expand roundtrips, negative and fractional constants, existing restrictions, and canonical IR preservation.
Only a source-identity free real symbol may be substituted into the closed Add/Subtract/Multiply/Square IR forms; bound variables and unsafe restricted substitution are refused.
Over real inputs sqrt(square(x)) becomes abs(x); only an explicitly typed x>=0 assumption permits x and must remain attached to the mathematical result.
Eight independent NuGet-only .NET 10 probes check exact transforms and refusal boundaries; no direct ProjectReference, external feed or CAS product dependency is introduced.
Three local product archives are inspected with a separate C# manifest/SHA-256 helper; the payload consumes product receipts and never recalculates workflow authority hashes.
Only C03-T1 R/G/V and T1 close; C03-T2, M4-W01 and M4 remain open, with broader substitution, resource bounds, general CAS proof and dw.discovery/AURA deferred.

RS057's first invocation was refused before attempt allocation: the 129-bit exact binomial coefficient incorrectly yielded Unsupported. The recognized pattern now returns BudgetExceeded without changing the 28 GREEN mathematical oracles.

The second RS057 invocation was refused before attempt allocation: consumer Program.cs line 35 failed CS8602. An explicit IrApply shape and length guard replaces the non-flow-aware Require call, retaining all eight oracles and all 28 scientific GREEN tests.

Third RS057 pre-attempt refusal: target re-entry checked /new_green_tests_passed, but qualified evidence writes /independent_green_tests_passed. Fixed the pointer; all target evidence checks, 28 GREEN tests and eight NuGet consumer probes were re-audited without weakening acceptance.
declared.nextAction: After durable RS057 success, prepare M4-W01-C03-T2 for separate bounded rule, assumptions/provenance, unsupported-form and cancellation tests before closing C03 and M4-W01.

Verify locked build, complete relevant symbolics/IR/quantities tests, a separate local three-product manifest/SHA-256 inspection and explicitly limited symbolic provenance.
Qualify M4-W01-C03-T1 as a provider-free exact binomial, safe free-substitution and real-square-root transformation contract without claiming general symbolic processing.
